A case interview shows how a candidate structures a problem. It shows little about how they check an AI draft against the client’s data.
Campus and experienced hires join the same client teams, and each pipeline screens for AI skills differently, if at all.
Start with a task that looks like client work
Choose a general task or one matched to a function such as finance. Candidates might check a client report against its source data.

See how the candidate checks the evidence
Source files open beside the brief, with spreadsheets shown as tables. Candidates check AI output against the data and catch deliberate errors in some tasks. Every assistant exchange is saved.
Review the score before the case interview
Fixed rules score deliverables against expert-defined criteria. No AI model grades responses. Recruiting teams and first-round interviewers review scores, assessed skills, integrity risk ratings and every prompt before deciding whom to invite to case interviews.
Assess the consultants you already have
Use the same tasks in Skills Intelligence to establish a baseline for existing consultants, plan upskilling and reassess against the same criteria.
Skills Intelligence for business teams
See the work behind the claim
A resume lists AI tools, and a case interview tests how a candidate structures a problem. Codility adds a client-style deliverable produced with AI, fixed-rule scoring and every prompt to review, backed by almost two decades of assessment science.
